description: Verify 1 to 50 email addresses in one request and return a verdict for each. Split longer lists into chunks of 50. Uses credits from the connected BillionVerify account.

check_smtp.description: Whether to perform SMTP checks for each email address.

emails.description: The email addresses to verify, with a minimum of 1 item and a maximum of 50 items.
